description.value:
Requirements You are broadcasting

Traits Signal

You place a repeater in an unoccupied 5-foot square within 30 feet. For 1 minute, your Broadcast's range is measured from the repeater as well as from you, so a creature within range of either is in range. The repeater is an object with AC 15 and 10 Hit Points; destroying it ends the effect early, as does ending your Broadcast.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element in the 34-key inventory (P12) creates a placed, independently-targetable object with its own AC/HP — that is a Foundry scene/token operation, well outside rule-element scope. Also SB3-adjacent (modifies where Broadcast's range is measured from).
